[IARC.12.4] **Upsert, cap-enforced.** An existing key is overwritten; `ttl_ns =
0` is no expiry; a non-zero one is a lifetime that counts from the engine's
first sample ([NLFC.9.4]), after which the entry expires as a `cache … ttl:`
entry does. The store must
enforce the cache bounds ([LSTO.4.7.5], set by `ds_engine_set_cache_cap`,
[NSTG.2.6.1]) before it mutates; a breach returns `DS_ERR_CONTRACT_BREACH` and
leaves the cache unchanged.
